summary: Defines a way for an access router to provide a shared key to a mobile node for protecting Fast Mobile IPv6 signaling, using Secure Neighbor Discovery (SEND). Fast Binding Updates must be secured to avoid certain attacks, and this gives the node and router a symmetric key to do so. The mobile node generates a public/private key pair for the exchange.

eli5.summary: Before two people can pass secret notes, they need to agree on a secret code. This describes how a router and a moving device safely agree on one, so no stranger can fake the notes.

questions: send secure neighbor discovery key exchange
how to secure fast binding update
